notes: A consent page may come first: choose Reject all. Google Flights: set origin and destination in the 'Where from?' and 'Where to?' comboboxes and pick the matching suggestion; the Departure field opens a calendar whose days show prices; 'Round trip' can be switched to 'One way'. Google Maps: the search box takes a place or 'cafe near X'; results list name, rating and address; opening a result shows its address.

procedures.description: On Google Flights, set a route from an origin to a destination.

steps.goal: Type {origin} into the combobox named Where from? and choose the matching suggestion.
Type {destination} into the combobox named Where to? and choose the matching suggestion.

procedures.description: Search Google Maps for a place or a kind of place.

steps.goal: Type {query} into the Google Maps search box and submit it.
